newsitem.title: USA: MedImmune begins Phase I HPV vaccine trial.
newsitem.headline: MedImmune begins Phase I HPV vaccine trial.

text.p: MedImmune Inc said on Monday that it has begun enrollment for a Phase I clinical trial with a vaccine for the prevention of human papillomavirus (HPV) disease of the genital tract.
MedImmune said it believes that the trial, being conducted at the University of Rochester Medical Center, represents the first evaluation in humans of a preventative HPV vaccine.
HPVs are responsible for the development of genital warts and cervical cancer.
According to the company, there are currently no vaccines to prevent these sexually transmitted diseases that affect 24 to 40 million men and women in the United States.
